tools.howToObtain: Sign in to KI-Toolbox with a KIT account, then select an external Claude model or use a self-generated API key.
tools.costToUser: Normal central service use has no personal charge; higher employee budgets require approval.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: KIT SCC's KI-Toolbox terms identify external Anthropic Claude models hosted on Google Cloud and grant access through KIT-account single sign-on. They distinguish these cloud models from SCC-operated local models and state provider training use is disabled.

The SCC KI-Toolbox API guide says KIT purchases the necessary usage quotas centrally and makes them available to users without normal personal cost. The service provides external cloud models separately from local SCC-operated models.

tools.description: KIT-procured Google Gemini models delivered through Google Cloud in the KI-Toolbox.
tools.howToObtain: Sign in to KI-Toolbox with a KIT account, then select an external Gemini model or use a self-generated API key.
tools.costToUser: Normal central service use has no personal charge; higher employee budgets require approval.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: KIT SCC's KI-Toolbox terms identify external Google Gemini models hosted on Google Cloud and grant access through KIT-account single sign-on. They distinguish these cloud models from SCC-operated local models and state provider training use is disabled.

The SCC KI-Toolbox API guide says KIT purchases the necessary usage quotas centrally and makes them available to users without normal personal cost. The service provides external cloud models separately from local SCC-operated models.

tools.description: SCC-operated local open-source generative-AI models in KIT's KI-Toolbox.
tools.howToObtain: Sign in to KI-Toolbox using the KIT account through single sign-on.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The KI-Toolbox is a service provided by the Scientific Computing Center (SCC) at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), accessed with a KIT account by single sign-on. It provides local open-source models operated at the SCC; local-model use is not charged to the budget.

coursework.en: Informatics permits uses consistent with course learning goals, subject to instructor variations.
coursework.zh: 信息学院按课程学习目标有条件允许使用生成式 AI，教师可另行规定。

exams.en: Examination-context KI-Toolbox use needs express approval by the responsible examination officials.
exams.zh: 在考试场景使用 KI-Toolbox 须取得考试负责人的明确许可。

disclosure.en: Informatics requires identification of AI use in assessed work, with correction/translation exceptions needing preservation.
disclosure.zh: 信息学院考核作品须按指南标注 AI 使用，保留校对和翻译的例外。

privacy_data.en: Personal data may be processed only with KIT-hosted local models; external Azure and Google models are excluded.
privacy_data.zh: 个人数据仅可通过 KIT 本地托管模型处理，不能经 Azure 或 Google 外部模型处理。

approved_tools.en: The Toolbox includes local and externally delivered models. Access is not permission for examinations.
approved_tools.zh: 工具箱提供本地和外部模型；可登录使用并不等于考试许可。

research_publication.en: KIT-wide guidelines defer to existing research and publisher rules; thesis-specific current policies need checking.
research_publication.zh: 校级指引不取代科研与出版规则，学位论文具体规则尚须核对。

academic_integrity.en: An unapproved aid may trigger applicable examination rules; specific oral/hearing mechanism and actor remain unverified in retained primary evidence.
academic_integrity.zh: 未获许可的辅助工具可能触及适用专业考试规程；具体口头说明机制与执行主体在现有保留证据中未经验证。

teaching_guidance.en: The ZML generator is optional; faculty and instructors set binding course rules.
teaching_guidance.zh: ZML 生成器非强制；具体课程规则由学院和任课教师确定。

security_procurement.en: SCC prohibits very-high-risk and export-controlled inputs; procurement workflow beyond service terms needs verification.
security_procurement.zh: SCC 禁止非常高风险及出口管制相关输入；采购流程仍须进一步确认。

coursework.en: KIT Faculty of Informatics orientation guide (15 January 2026); programme- and course-specific examination regulations govern student work.
coursework.zh: KIT信息学系导向指南（2026年1月15日）；学生课程作业受所在专业考试规章及课程具体要求约束。

exams.en: KI-Toolbox usage conditions; using KI-Toolbox in an examination context requires explicit permission from the responsible examiner.
exams.zh: KI-Toolbox使用条款；在考试或考核场景中使用KI-Toolbox必须事先取得主考教师的明确许可。

disclosure.en: KIT Faculty of Informatics guide; material AI contributions must be documented (tool, version/model, prompts or usage scope), while purely trivial language/formatting edits may be exempt.
disclosure.zh: KIT信息学系指南；实质性AI贡献须予以记录披露（工具名称、版本/模型、提示词或作用范围），仅涉及纯文字润色或排版的轻微辅助可按指南例外处理。

privacy_data.en: KI-Toolbox privacy and model-hosting rules; personal data may only be entered into locally hosted models at KIT and never into externally hosted Azure or Google models.
privacy_data.zh: KI-Toolbox隐私与模型托管规则；个人数据仅可输入KIT本地托管模型，严禁输入外部托管的Azure或Google模型。

approved_tools.en: KIT KI-Toolbox (available to staff, guests, and from April 2026 students with a 5 USD/month standard budget from July 2026); access is not blanket assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: KIT KI-Toolbox（面向教职工、访客及自2026年4月起面向学生开放，2026年7月起设每月5美元标准额度）；工具访问权限不等于通用考核许可。

research_publication.en: KIT recommendations for generative AI in research and scientific publications.
research_publication.zh: KIT关于在科研与学术发表中使用生成式AI的建议指南。

academic_integrity.en: KIT Faculty of Informatics guide (retaining literal three-week artifact evaluation timing excerpt; specific procedure mechanism and actor unverified); university-wide formal misconduct appeal deadlines remain unverified.
academic_integrity.zh: KIT信息学系指南（保留作业成果批改后至迟三周的原条文；具体程序机制与执行主体未经验证）；全校正式违纪申诉期限尚待核实。

teaching_guidance.en: KIT teaching support and syllabus policy-generator guidance for instructors.
teaching_guidance.zh: 面向任课教师的KIT教学支持与课程AI规则生成器指引。

security_procurement.en: KI-Toolbox model-hosting and data-protection architecture separating local KIT models from external cloud providers.
security_procurement.zh: 区分KIT本地托管模型与外部云服务商的KI-Toolbox模型托管及数据保护架构。

title.en: Check the rules for your work

scope.en: KI-Toolbox availability is not general assessment permission (explicit examiner permission is required in examination contexts); the Informatics guide applies to the KIT Faculty of Informatics, and personal data may only be processed in locally hosted KIT models, never external Azure or Google models.
scope.zh: KI-Toolbox的可用性不代表通用考核许可（考试场景须取得主考教师明确许可）；信息学系指南仅适用于KIT信息学系，且个人数据仅可在KIT本地托管模型中处理，严禁输入外部Azure或Google模型。

do.en: Check your assessment rules and obtain explicit examination permission.
do.zh: 核对考核规则并取得明确的考试许可。

dont.en: Do not put personal data into external Azure or Google models.
dont.zh: 不要将个人数据输入 Azure 或 Google 外部模型。
